name: RealMap
summary: Turn a real place into a Transport Fever 3 map with the free RealMap desktop app
description:
Builds, in the Map Editor, a map of a real-world area prepared by the free RealMap desktop app: relief, sea, rivers and lakes, biomes, towns at their real size, named industries, road links and a railway.
Get the app: https://github.com/Spit8/RealMap/releases/latest
